dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent and sharp pale edges create distinct linear boundaries along the outer webs of the folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse transition where the relatively uniform brown crown meets a high-frequency scaled pattern on the upper nape.

other_distinctive_markers: Exceptional contrast between dark feather centers and wide, pale fringes across the dorsal surface, creating a distinct repetitive imbricated pattern.
